title: Checkout with SAVE10
objective: Go to {{app_url}}. Enter SAVE10 in Coupon code and click Apply coupon. Store the displayed Total as 'displayed_total'. Assert that Total is 90 dollars, even if the coupon status reports no discount. Place the order. Store its order identifier as 'order_id'. Reload the page. Open Order history. Assert that the same order is shown with Caustica Field Notes, coupon SAVE10 and a 90 dollar total.

requirements.description: SAVE10 changes the visible total from $100.00 to $90.00.
Place order persists Caustica Field Notes, SAVE10 and a $90.00 total.
Order history shows the same order and amount after refresh.
